DIAGNOSIS READY: Conduct Disorder.

The patient's refusal to follow authority, specifically the "You're not the boss of me" remarks and defiance in class, alongside selective engagement in activities (refusing gym but playing during recess), are classic signs of oppositional defiant disorder.
